_comment: Canonical Central Government ministry/department list for the rtionline.gov.in request form. This is a HINT used for the green/amber autocomplete badge only. The real safety net is content.js, which reconciles against the LIVE <select> options at fill time, so this file drifting out of date never blocks a fill.
_refresh: To refresh: open https://rtionline.gov.in/request/request.php, inspect the ministry/department <select>, and copy its option label texts into the `ministries` array below (trimmed, exact case). Update `version` to the refresh date. The order here does not matter; the app sorts for display.
